### Known gaps

- Operations added by the SDK bump and not yet implemented (listed in sdk_completeness_test.go notImplemented): GetSystemLogsForJobRun, GetSystemLogsForSession. Both return a SystemLogsUrl into AWS-managed Spark driver/executor system logs; this emulator runs no Spark and keeps no such logs, so any URL would be fabricated (UNVERIFIABLE: no data source exists).
- Request members accepted and ignored with no determinable effect: Tags on CreateColumnStatisticsTaskSettings/CreateIntegrationResourceProperty/RegisterConnectionType/CreateCustomEntityType (the Glue ARN guide lists no ARN for them); UpdateTable VersionId/Force/ViewUpdateAction (UpdateTable API reference names no mismatch behavior); ModifyIntegration.IntegrationName (ARN is name-keyed); Get/ResetJobBookmark.RunId (one bookmark per job; per-run semantics undocumented); GetConnection.ApplyOverrideForComputeEnvironment; GetTable/GetTables/SearchTables IncludeStatusDetails; GetDatabases/SearchTables ResourceShareType (no cross-account shares).
- Crawler gaps: JDBC engines are postgresql/mysql/redshift only; CatalogTargets recrawl existing S3, DynamoDB and Delta tables only (DeleteBehavior is always LOG per the console docs; EventQueueArn/DlqEventQueueArn are validated and stored but no SQS events are consumed; Iceberg/Hudi-backed catalog tables are rejected, matching the documented S3/DynamoDB/Delta-only rule); MongoDB crawls sample or scan through the Go driver against the connection's CONNECTION_URL (table name is <database>_<collection>, _id renders as struct<oid:string>; the naming and the oid shape are best-effort, not verified against a real catalog); DynamoDB scanRate is accepted but never throttles (no RCU accounting); CRAWL_EVENT_MODE is not event driven; Delta native-table and DEPRECATED_BY_CRAWLER parameter names are best-effort (not verified against a real catalog).
- PublishDataQualityResultV2 members with no read path in glue@v1.170.0 are accepted and not stored: RunConfiguration, Statistics, Telemetry, DataQualitySecurityConfiguration. Published results carry no DataSource/ProfileId, so a ListDataQualityResultsV2 DataSource filter matches nothing and GetDataQualityResultV2 omits both.
- Interactive sessions run statements only with --glue-engine=docker (GLUE_ENGINE, or --engines=docker): CreateSession then starts a long-lived container (public.ecr.aws/glue/aws-glue-libs image per GlueVersion, or GLUE_ENGINE_IMAGE) holding a persistent Python REPL (pyspark/GlueContext preloaded for glueetl/gluestreaming). With the engine disabled (default) RunStatement on a READY session returns a statement in ERROR whose Output.ErrorValue says how to enable it; no output is fabricated. Not modeled even with the engine: the session Role's credentials and S3 endpoint wiring inside the container, WorkerType/NumberOfWorkers resource limits (recorded only), Connections, SecurityConfiguration, Session Progress/DPUSeconds/ExecutionTime/ProfileName, and the default AWS Glue image tags are not pull-verified in CI. Interpreter state does not survive a gopherstack restart: restored READY sessions fail on the next RunStatement, restored queued/running statements become ERROR.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- StartMaterializedViewRefreshTaskRun.FullRefresh and the RequestOrigin members on session/statement ops have no corresponding output field in glue@v1.157.0, so nothing observable exists to emulate; ClientToken on Put*/Update*/Associate*/Disassociate* ops is already idempotent by key.
- No backing engine or data: Lake Formation cell/row filtering (GetUnfiltered*Metadata) and catalog federation; GetDataQualityResult metrics/rule results and StartDataQualityRulesetEvaluationRun evaluation; ListConnectionTypes DisplayName/LogoUrl/Vendor (no connector catalog); GetPlan Location/Sinks (code generation); GetEntityRecords ConnectionOptions/SelectedFields (real connectors); FindMatchesTaskRunProperties JobId/JobName/JobRunId (no transform job).
- Table-format and snapshot semantics need a real engine: GetTable AttributesToGet Iceberg metadata, Create/UpdateTable OpenTableFormatInput, and TransactionId/AuditContext/QueryAsOfTime/QuerySessionContext on table and partition ops.
- ConcurrentModificationException and OperationTimeoutException cannot occur: the coarse b.mu serializes ops and there is no timeout source. ResourceNumberLimitExceededException is real for 15 ops (limits.go).
- DataCatalogExportConfiguration.S3TableBucketArn has no input to derive from and ENABLING/DISABLING are not modeled (no async export).

### Deferred

- workflows: BlueprintDetails and WorkflowRun.Graph's per-node run details (JobDetails.JobRuns/CrawlerDetails.Crawls) remain unmodeled -- the job/crawler-run-to-workflow-run link they'd need now exists (gopherstack-vcor), but converting it into per-node run lists is separate work; this backend also never evaluates conditional (predicate-gated) triggers, so only a workflow's entry trigger ever links actions to a run
- ML transforms: EvaluationMetrics (FindMatchesMetrics) — no real ML evaluation is ever run, so there is no real metric to report
